name: nokia-s40-dp2.0
_comment: Series 40 Developer Platform 2.0 (reference phone Nokia 6230), numbers from the Nokia S40 DP2.0 SDK 1.1 (local, gitignored, not in the repo). Source tags: sdk: / datasheet: / measured: / UNVERIFIED (ProfileValidator). SDK files: UG = User Guide pdf, RN = Release_Notes.txt, EM = emulator S40_DP20_1_1_em.dll (string table of the native emulator), API = sdk/api javadoc.

_sources.heapBytes: sdk: Nokia_S40_DP20_SDK_1_1_User_Guide.pdf 'Setting the KVM heapsize': maximum heapsize for the Nokia 6230 is 1,024,000 bytes
_sources.jarMaxBytes: sdk: Nokia_S40_DP20_SDK_1_1_User_Guide.pdf 'Running MIDlets in non-provisioning mode': maximum JAR size that the Nokia 6230 can use is 357,000 bytes
_sources.maxClassMajor: UNVERIFIED (preverify1.1.exe in the SDK output class version 48 for CLDC1.1? not verified; 49 is the parser limit)

_sources.priorityScheduling: UNVERIFIED (V2/V4: Nokia KVM thread scheduling not measured)

_sources.apis: sdk: Release_Notes.txt 'Features' JSR list: 139, 118, 185, 120 v1.1 (WMA), 135 audio only, 82. JSR 82 has no layer yet; JSR-75 is not in the list, so no jsr75-*
